DATE COLLECTED: [redacted date]
DATE RECEIVED: [redacted date]
DATE REPORTED: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Rule out Down syndrome

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded chromosome analysis

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

No evidence of trisomy 21 or other significant chromosomal abnormalities detected.

METHOD
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured, harvested and G-banded according to standard protocols. Twenty metaphases were analyzed. Analysis quality was sufficient for exclusion of numerical and major structural abnormalities.

INTERPRETATION
Normal female karyotype. No evidence of Down syndrome.

This report supersedes the previous rapid PCR analysis performed on this patient.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director: [redacted name], MD, PhD
